description: 【提供:国土交通省航空局】空港管理状況調書 [airports] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 公益社団法人　土木学会. 空港別の離着陸回数、旅客数、貨物量など. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 公益社団法人　土木学会. It offers 2 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
